evidence: News leading into November 15, 2018, is dominated by severe market-wide capitulation. Bitcoin decisively broke its year-long critical $6,000 support level, plunging to fresh 2018 lows between $5,500 and $5,600. The aggressive sell-off is being fueled by broader market panic surrounding the contentious Bitcoin Cash hard fork and exchange trading halts (such as Coinbase pausing BCH trading and withdrawals on November 15). The sheer volume of the technical breakdown and heightened systemic uncertainty suggest strong negative momentum and continued downward pressure over the next 24 hours.
limitations: Several evidence items discuss unrelated corporate announcements or long-term macroeconomic views (e.g. IMF commentary, Yandex surveys) and were omitted as direct 24-hour signals.
